purpose: Define how adjacent education, business, and crosswalk datasets may be evaluated without unblocking preserved legacy tables or producing inferred recommendations.
allowedUses: manual evidence comparison against source-backed cbps, muns, and unis facts
forbiddenUses: rank municipalities, schools, businesses, or categories
infer demand, profitability, employment outcomes, or graduation-to-industry rates

requiredBoundaries: Must remain CIP/program context unless a source-backed NAICS relationship is found.
Must not imply occupational outcomes from crosswalk-only evidence.
Must not import officer, director, owner, point-of-contact, phone, email, or personal address fields.
Must not populate businesses without physical address, point coordinate, and cdepts join evidence.
Must document geocoding and license obligations before any point display.
Must be labeled as crosswalk context, not observed Puerto Rico outcome data.
Must not create cdepts ids used by preserved businesses or grade_cs joins.
Must not be used as a scoring model.

requiredValidationRules: candidate sources must not set importEnabled true
candidate sources must not set sourceBackedLegacyTable true
candidate sources must document Puerto Rico scope or keep scope unresolved
education sources using CIP must state that they do not produce source-backed NAICS or cdepts rates
business and POI sources must state coordinate, NAICS, license, and cdepts join limitations
crosswalk sources must be context-only and must not synthesize rows
sources with person or contact fields must define minimization before demo or API exposure
promotionRequirements: Add a planning-specific schema that does not reuse blocked legacy table names.
Record source URL, license, scope filter, publication date, and row-level provenance.
Define privacy minimization rules before any business or education contact fields are read.
Keep output copy explicitly descriptive and non-recommendation.
Add dry-run fixtures and tests before any API or UI exposure.
